withheld_conflicts.note: Source/key conflict: 'had' is the main verb followed by the noun phrase 'all her classes', so the printed sentence is simple past (A). Past perfect requires had + a past participle. The Commission's provisional key marks (B), Past perfect. That official entry is retained in the attached key; scoring is withheld rather than silently replacing it. Grammar reference: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/free-resources/grammar/english-grammar-reference/past-perfect

Source/key conflict: the printed sentence uses future perfect (will have + past participle), but no future perfect choice is printed. The Commission's provisional key marks (C), Future perfect continuous. The printed choices and official key document are preserved; no scoring answer is assigned. Grammar reference: https://learnenglish.britishcouncil.org/free-resources/grammar/b1-b2/future-continuous-future-perfect
